svg.text: FIRST-PRINCIPLES LLM CAPACITY SIZING (ROOFLINE / 6ND / KV), XPROF & GOODPUT TRIAGE
Roofline Sizing + XProf Async Overlap + 3-Factor Goodput Lifts Real Yield 4.57x (12.5% -> 57.1%)
1,024-Chip 70B/15T Run: Tier 1 Blind Scaling (21.5% MFU x 58% Goodput, $2.65M/mo) vs. Tier 4 (59.2% MFU x 96.5% Goodput, $580K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: 95% "Busy" Chips Delivering 12.5% Yield
1. Confusing Chip Utilization with MFU x Goodput (12.5% Yield):
• Chips report 95% busy while spinning on exposed DCN AllReduce
barriers or recomputing 30 min of lost `Badput` after a crash
2. Ignoring Roofline Ridge Points (TPU7x 626 / H200 206 FLOPs/B):
• Running small-batch Decode (`AI ~ 1-16 FLOPs/B`) on compute-heavy
chips starves `MXU/TensorCore` behind HBM bandwidth limits
3. Undiagnosed Input Starvation & Unpadded Matrix Tiles (21.5% MFU):
• Non-128/256 multiples waste systolic array tiles; host I/O stalls
Production Failure Impact (1,024-Chip Training & Serving):
• Sustained MFU: 21.5% | ML Productivity Goodput: 58.0%
• Effective Cluster FLOP Yield (`MFU x Goodput`): Only 12.5%!
• Monthly Wasted Cluster & Serving TCO: $2,650,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Roofline Math + XProf Triage + 3-Factor Goodput
1. First-Principles `6ND` + `16B/Param` + `KV Cache` Hand Sizing:
• Sizes exact FSDP/TP sharding, batch `AI >= Ridge Point`, and
disaggregates compute-bound Prefill from HBM-bound Decode (78.5% MBU)
2. 4-Step XProf / Nsight Triage Tree (59.2% Sustained MFU):
• Eliminates (1) Host Infeed gaps, (2) XLA recompiles, (3) Exposed
`AllGather/ReduceScatter` via async overlap, (4) `128x128` tile waste
3. Google 3-Factor ML Productivity Goodput (96.5% Goodput):
• `Scheduling x Runtime x Progress` eliminates rollback Badput
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Sustained MFU: 59.2% | 3-Factor ML Goodput: 96.5%
• Real Cluster Yield (`MFU x Goodput`): 57.1% (4.57x vs. Tier 1)
• Monthly Wasted Compute TCO: $580,000 / mo (-78.1% waste reduction)
